name: Carney & Sloan Inc
old_description: Family owned and operated since 1997, Carney & Sloan, Inc. specializes in food service equipment and supplies, sales and service. Operating out of Wheeling, West Virginia, Carney & Sloan has long served the Wheeling and Tri-State area servicing restaurants, churches, schools, healthcare, convenient stores, taverns, fraternal organizations, food trucks and more. Our showroom is open to the public or we are a simple phone call away. We pride ourselves on excellent customer relations and service and fast local delivery and installation within the Tri-State area.
about:
Carney & Sloan Inc is a family-owned food service equipment and supplies company founded in 1997 by Mike Carney and Ron Sloan in Wheeling, West Virginia. In December 2023, ownership transferred to Patrick and Christine Opferman, who also operate Opferman Mechanical in Pittsburgh, bringing combined decades of industry experience.

The company provides complete kitchen layout and design, engineering, installation, sales, and service for commercial food service equipment. It operates a public showroom at 518 Main Street in Wheeling and stocks thousands of items ranging from smallwares to large equipment such as walk-in coolers, freezers, combi-ovens, cooking equipment, and beverage systems. A dedicated team handles CAD-based kitchen design, equipment delivery, installation, and ongoing service for hot-side, HVAC, and refrigeration systems.

Carney & Sloan serves restaurants, hotels, health care facilities, schools, clubs and organizations, convenience stores, churches, and food trucks throughout the Wheeling tri-state area. Customers include both independent operators and institutional buyers seeking turnkey kitchen solutions.

The company emphasizes exceptional customer service, fast local delivery and installation, and an extensive in-stock inventory as its core differentiators, aiming to make kitchen upgrades hassle-free for its clients.
